how_made: The 500 English test_sub sentences rewritten as casual Hinglish by the same Gemini model; intent labels are MASSIVE's. T and t are the ones chosen on dev data, not re-tuned.
caveat: The same LLM family wrote and classifies the Hinglish, which may flatter the LLM-only number.
